mentions.name: RPGUni
mentions.description: A TTRPG toolset for managing tabletop RPG universes. Features a dynamic entity system for creating custom entities with their own traits, random tables, and a madlibs-style generator that work together—tables can randomly pick other tables' values or reference custom entities, all of which can be tied to maps and calendars. Worlds can be shared out as a published gazetteer and encyclopedia, and entities can reference parameters in other entities so embedded data has a single source of truth. Still early in development.
mentions.problem: Existing systems were too clunky, and wikis don't offer the same level of control and reuse.
